# Bundled Claude Code doc references (curated)

This directory is the version anchor for mentat's diagnostics. It mixes
**real fetched content** with **curated pointers** — each is labelled so nothing
is misrepresented as official doc text.

## Real fetched content (regenerated by `scripts/refresh_docs.sh`)

- `CHANGELOG.md` — full upstream changelog, **version-keyed** (`## <version>`).
  This is the authoritative anchor: it states exactly what changed in the
  installed version.
- `changelog-<version>.md` — the section for the currently installed
  `claude --version`, extracted from the changelog.
- `doc-urls.tsv` — `name<TAB>http_status<TAB>url` for each canonical doc page,
  recorded at last sync (proves reachability without dumping multi-MB HTML).
- `SYNC.md` — which version the references were synced against, plus the known
  per-version-docs gap note.

## Curated pointers (hand-written, kept short and verifiable)

Canonical docs live at `code.claude.com/docs` (served at HEAD — there are no
per-version doc URLs). Use these as entry points when a diagnosis needs the
authoritative spec for an artifact type:

| Topic | URL | Use when diagnosing |
|---|---|---|
| Overview | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview | general behaviour, entrypoints |
| Slash commands | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/slash-commands | a `/command` misfires or won't load |
| Sub-agents | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents | an agent's frontmatter/triggering is wrong |
| Skills | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills | a SKILL.md won't activate or mis-scopes |
| Plugins | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins | manifest/structure/marketplace issues |
| Hooks | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks | a hook blocks, loops, or never fires |
| Troubleshooting | https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshooting | crashes, freezes, install/runtime faults |

## How "stay up to date" works

`scripts/refresh_docs.sh` reads `claude --version`, re-fetches the changelog and
the version section, re-verifies the doc URLs, and rewrites `SYNC.md`. Run it
whenever Claude Code updates. See `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/references/REFRESH.md`
for the full contract.
